lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns along the visible posterior flank; at least four columns are discernible, typically containing three spots each.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance spots to create a visible grid-like pattern on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal ridge feature with a light-to-dark vertical pixel gradient is visible running across the mid-section of the visible flank towards the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: At least two distinct high-luminance spots are visible on the distal posterior edge of the first dorsal fin silhouette at the rightmost edge of the frame.
